changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, system_user, password_expires_at, password_change_required, tenant_id, profile_completed, enabled, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, version) SELECT 'service-account-keycloak-manager', '{noop}service-account-keycloak-manager-disabled-password', true, '2038-01-19 03:14:07', false, (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE code = 'default'), true, true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system', 'system', 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = 'service-account-keycloak-manager' AND tenant_id = (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE code = 'default') );

INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id, tenant_id) SELECT u.id, r.id, t.id FROM users u CROSS JOIN tenants t JOIN roles r ON r.code = 'ADMIN' AND r.tenant_id = t.id WHERE u.username = 'service-account-keycloak-manager' AND u.tenant_id = t.id AND t.code = 'default' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.role_id = r.id );
